lead: `looper` may not be on a session's `PATH`, and the user's registry `Path` may name a deleted looper.
body: `looper self-update` puts each build in a new `E:\loop-plan-tool\var\bin\<version>-<hash>\` and deletes older ones, so the registry entry the driver reads can name a directory that is gone. Run the newest directory's `looper.exe` by its full path (`Get-ChildItem E:\loop-plan-tool\var\bin` sorted by time), and say in the handoff which one you ran. `tools/nv/driver/handover.ts` resolves looper from that same registry entry.
